metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: Community Screening Resource Allocation
decision.domain: Biostatistics, population health, public policy, and operations
decision.question: Choose a 12-month screening-delivery strategy under a USD 10 million budget while improving access and limiting implementation risk.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

fixed-site-expansion.label: Expand fixed clinics
fixed-site-expansion.description: Add evening capacity and two permanent community screening sites.

mobile-first.label: Mobile-first network
mobile-first.description: Deploy mobile units using rotating rural and underserved-neighborhood schedules.

hybrid-targeted.label: Targeted hybrid
hybrid-targeted.description: Combine extended fixed-site hours with one risk-targeted mobile unit.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic demonstration assumptions informed by a hypothetical needs assessment
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
sources: Illustrative expert elicitation on capacity and implementation risk
evidence.causal_claim_status: No causal claim; health gains are scenario inputs that would require trial or quasi-experimental evidence in a real deployment.
limitations: Health gains are aggregate and do not model disease-specific survival outcomes.
Geographic travel times are summarized rather than optimized on a road network.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A real analysis should estimate health outcomes by condition and validate transportability across districts.
The authority should pre-register an evaluation plan before rollout.
